context: Mari is on duty at an entrance she was about to unlock and expects to be the one to open it. When she finds the door already ajar she voices confusion because she didn't unlock it. Off-screen, several different causes could explain this in different playthroughs: another NPC (or the player) might have already opened it, a hidden mechanism/password or key could have revealed and unlocked the door, the door could have been destroyed, or magical/other forces might have altered it. Related dialogue branches handle those cases differently (e.g., extreme confusion if destroyed, normal greeting if she then unlocks it, or simple puzzlement if it’s mysteriously unlocked).
